purpose: Skip-and-fill 50-record batch 103: fifty independently reviewed 3.5-era spell records selected from the 761-record reference-dependent queue. Truncated Summon Desert Ally IX, table-driven Polymorph Any Object, older 3.0/transition printings, ambiguous references, and source-damaged candidates were deliberately skipped. Family roots are reviewed in the same batch where needed; all other inherited spell mechanics resolve to already reviewed records.

spells/summon-desert-ally-i-3137.name: Summon Desert Ally I
spells/summon-desert-ally-i-3137.effectSummary: Summons one dustform creature from the spell's 1st-level Summon Desert Ally list as dustform creatures for 1 round per caster level. Each creature appears where you designate and acts immediately on your turn, attacking your opponents by default; if you can communicate with it, you can direct it not to attack, to attack particular enemies, or to take other actions. A summoned creature cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature or use teleportation or planar-travel abilities, and it cannot be summoned into an environment that cannot support it. Creatures on the Summon Desert Ally lists are neutral unless otherwise noted.
spells/summon-desert-ally-i-3137.notes: Sandstorm printing, digest-locked after manual review of the self-contained root effect. The classifier's generic external-reference hit is not an inherited spell dependency.

provenance.role: primary Sandstorm catalog record and digest source

spells/summon-desert-ally-ii-3138.name: Summon Desert Ally II
spells/summon-desert-ally-ii-3138.effectSummary: Summons one 2nd-level creature or 1d3 1st-level creatures of the same kind as dustform creatures for 1 round per caster level. Each creature appears where you designate and acts immediately on your turn, attacking your opponents by default; if you can communicate with it, you can direct it not to attack, to attack particular enemies, or to take other actions. A summoned creature cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature or use teleportation or planar-travel abilities, and it cannot be summoned into an environment that cannot support it. Creatures on the Summon Desert Ally lists are neutral unless otherwise noted. When multiple creatures are called, they must appear within 30 feet of one another.
spells/summon-desert-ally-ii-3138.notes: Sandstorm printing, digest-locked. Summon Desert Ally I is reviewed in this same batch and supplies the shared dustform summoning chassis; this record preserves its own level-list and quantity choices.

spells/conjure-ice-beast-ii-1239.name: Conjure Ice Beast II
spells/conjure-ice-beast-ii-1239.effectSummary: Creates one creature from the 2nd-level list or two creatures of the same kind from the 1st-level list using the summon monster or summon nature's ally lists, excluding creatures with the fire subtype. Each creature is a construct made of magical ice with the ice beast template, appears where you designate, and acts immediately on your turn, attacking opponents by default or following other directions if you can communicate with it. The creatures cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature, cannot use teleportation or planar-travel abilities, and cannot be created in an environment that cannot support them. Multiple creatures must be within 30 feet of one another.

spells/halasters-fetch-ii-335.name: Halaster's Fetch II
spells/halasters-fetch-ii-335.effectSummary: Calls one creature from the 2nd-level list or 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 1st-level list using the corresponding Summon Monster rules: each creature appears where designated and acts immediately, attacking opponents by default or following directions if you can communicate with it; it cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature or use teleportation or planar-travel abilities, and the environment must support it. spells/weather-eye-682.name: Weather Eye
spells/weather-eye-682.effectSummary: After a 1-hour casting, accurately predicts the natural weather in the spell's large surrounding area for up to one week into the future. If unnatural forces are currently altering the weather, the spell instead provides Detect Magic-style information about the magical influence, including aura presence and progressively more detail about number, strength, location, and school where applicable. Material component: incense. Divine focus: a scrying device such as a bowl, mirror, or crystal ball.
spells/weather-eye-682.notes: Complete Divine printing, digest-locked. Detect Magic is expanded only for the explicitly inherited analysis of unnatural weather.

provenance.role: primary Complete Divine catalog record and digest source
Player's Handbook v.3.5 source for inherited Detect Magic aura-analysis mechanics

spells/spikes-749.name: Spikes
spells/spikes-749.effectSummary: For 1 hour per caster level, one melee weapon with a wooden striking surface grows magical spikes. It deals both piercing and bludgeoning damage, gains a +2 enhancement bonus on attack rolls, deals +1 additional damage per caster level to a maximum +10, and has its threat range doubled. It does not work on bows, arrows, or weapons without a wooden striking surface.
spells/spikes-749.notes: Complete Divine printing, digest-locked. Brambles supplies the wooden-weapon and bonus-damage chassis; this spell increases the enhancement bonus, extends the duration, and doubles threat range.

spells/scrying-greater-2513.name: Scrying, Greater
spells/scrying-greater-2513.effectSummary: As Scrying, you create a remote sensor that can see and hear a creature at any distance if it fails the familiarity-modified Will save; the sensor follows the subject at up to 150 feet and uses your visual acuity, while a successful save prevents another attempt on that subject for 24 hours. Greater Scrying is cast as a standard action and lasts 1 hour per caster level. Detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, detect magic, message, read magic, and tongues function reliably through its sensor rather than using ordinary Scrying's percentage chance.
spells/scrying-greater-2513.notes: Player's Handbook v.3.5 printing, digest-locked. Scrying supplies the sensor, familiarity-save, tracking, and retry rules; the standard-action casting, extended duration, and reliable through-sensor spell list are source-specific.

provenance.role: primary Player's Handbook v.3.5 catalog record and digest source
Player's Handbook v.3.5 source for inherited Scrying mechanics

spells/teleport-object-2460.name: Teleport Object
spells/teleport-object-2460.effectSummary: Teleports one touched object weighing up to 50 pounds per caster level and occupying up to 3 cubic feet per caster level using Teleport's same-plane range, familiarity, off-target, similar-area, and mishap rules. Creatures and magical forces cannot be targets. Instead of a normal destination, the object can be sent to a distant point on the Ethereal Plane; the departure point then remains faintly magical, and a successful targeted dispel magic on that point returns the object.
spells/teleport-object-2460.notes: Player's Handbook v.3.5 printing, digest-locked. Teleport supplies the destination range and accuracy/mishap mechanics; the object-only target and Ethereal-storage option are source-specific.

provenance.role: primary Player's Handbook v.3.5 catalog record and digest source

spells/summon-warforged-champion-4906.effectSummary: Summons a single advanced warforged titan using the normal Summon Monster IX timing and control rules. The titan has 24 HD and 172 hp; BAB +18; grapple +35; axe +25 melee (2d8+9/×3) or maul +25 melee (2d8+9/×3); Fort +8, Ref +7, Will +8; Jump +44; Great Cleave; Greater Powerful Charge, raising its extra charge damage to +4d6; and Improved Damage Reduction twice, raising its DR to 12/adamantine. While it is active, controlled, and within 15 feet of you, it grants you a +5 shield bonus to AC.
